gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the Dell Pro Rugged 12 (RA02260) fits the same Gamber-Johnson 12-inch vehicle docks as the older Latitude 7230 Rugged Extreme. One example is the Lite Port, No RF dock 7160-1772-00 at $1,032: it takes 19.5 V DC input, no power supply is included and Gamber-Johnson recommends the Lind 120 W adapter. Gamber-Johnson also sells a THIN FZ-G1 dock (7170-0931-00) that is marked NOT COMPATIBLE with the FZ-G2, which is the exception behind Panasonic's 'most' G1 docks.
standout_why: I compared against both cited Panasonic pages. connect.na.panasonic.com/toughbook/rugged-laptops-tablets/toughbook-g2 says only that the G2 'keeps backward compatibility to most CF-20 and FZ-G1 docks', without naming a dock that fails. The eu.connect.panasonic.com/ch G2 page makes no claim about earlier generations. Of the top results, itechguides.com covers the Latitude 7230 but says only 'Industrial vehicle and desktop docks may be available' and nothing about whether accessories carry across generations. The rottenwifi.com page timed out twice, so I could not check it. ChatGPT's Dell result (rank 16) is the Latitude 7030 10-inch shop page, not the Pro Rugged 12 it showed as a card. None of these pages says whether the $3,498 Dell Pro Rugged 12 drops into existing 7230 vehicle docks, and none names the G1 dock that does not take a G2.
decides: For a fleet that already has 12-inch Dell 7230 or Panasonic G1 vehicle docks, this decides the pick: the Dell Pro Rugged 12 and the Panasonic G2 MK3 are the upgrades that keep the installed docks. A Gamber-Johnson G1/G2 dock costs $886 and a Dell 12-inch dock $1,032 before the power adapter, so switching platforms means paying for new docks on top of the tablets. For Android, Samsung says the Tab Active5 Pro is 'backward compatible with existing accessories', and Gamber-Johnson's slim keyboard fits both the Active4 Pro and Active5 Pro, but on either one only when the tablet is in Samsung's Rubber Boot. A Getac UX10 buyer outside the US, UK, EU, Australia and New Zealand cannot order the 5G module. The finding does not change the pick for buyers with no existing docks.

findings.label: Vehicle dock shared with the Latitude 7230
findings.value: Gamber-Johnson 7160-1772-00, 'Dell 12" Rugged Tablet Vehicle Docking Station; Lite Port – NO RF', $1,032, 'Compatible with the Dell Latitude 7230 Rugged Extreme and Pro Rugged 12 RA02260 tablet computer'
findings.source_title: Dell 12″ Rugged Tablet Vehicle Docking Station; Lite Port – NO RF | Gamber-Johnson
findings.note: This is the dock maker's own product page. I did not open a Dell document that confirms it.

findings.label: Power for dock 7160-1772-00
findings.value: 19.5 V DC input. Power supply not included. Gamber-Johnson recommends the Lind 120 W adapter (7300-0714) and says 90 W is sufficient, with 120 W worth considering if performance issues occur.
findings.source_title: Dell 12″ Rugged Tablet Vehicle Docking Station; Lite Port – NO RF | Gamber-Johnson
findings.note: The page does not mention keyboards, cases or the older 7220/7212 tablets.

findings.label: Panasonic's dock backward-compatibility claim
findings.value: 'keeps backward compatibility to most CF-20 and FZ-G1 docks'
findings.source_title: TOUGHBOOK G2 | Panasonic North America - United States
findings.note: This is the rival page ChatGPT cited. It does not say which docks are excluded.

findings.label: G1/G2 shared vehicle dock
findings.value: Gamber-Johnson 7160-0487-00, 'Panasonic TOUGHBOOK G2 / Toughpad G1 Docking Station, No RF', $886. Fits the G2 and FZ-G1 'with small or large bumper guards' and 'accommodates the tablet's extended battery, smart card reader, rear hand strap and large bumper guards'. 16 V DC input, power adapter not included.
findings.source_title: Panasonic TOUGHBOOK® G2 / Toughpad G1 Docking Station, No RF, VESA Hole Pattern | Gamber-Johnson
findings.note: This is the dock maker's own page. It does not mention xPAK modules.

findings.label: FZ-G1 dock that excludes the G2
findings.value: Gamber-Johnson 7170-0931-00 'Toughpad FZ-G1 THIN Docking Station': 'Compatible with the Panasonic Toughpad FZ-G1 with small bumper guards NOT COMPATIBLE WITH THE FZ-G2'. Listed at $710.23.
findings.source_title: Gamber Johnson Panasonic Toughpad FZ-G1 THIN Docking Station, No RF with LIND 11-16V Auto Power Adapter 7170-0931-00 | The Rugged Store
findings.note: This is a retailer quoting the Gamber-Johnson feature text. I did not open Gamber-Johnson's own page for this part.

findings.label: Battery packs and AC adapter
findings.value: Standard 11.4 V 4,360 mAh (50 Wh). Extended and Quick Release packs 10.8 V 6,300 mAh (68 Wh). AC adapter output 15.6 V DC, 7.05 A. Battery life: MK3 11 h standard / 15 h extended, MK2 7/12 h (MobileMark 25).
findings.note: The page also says each expansion area takes only one xPAK option and that xPAKs are end-user replaceable. MK2 uses a 12th-gen Core i5/i7. MK3 uses a Core Ultra 5 135U.

findings.label: Samsung's accessory statements
findings.value: 'backward compatible with existing accessories'. 'Extra replaceable battery and POGO charging dock sold separately'. For replacement batteries, 'only Samsung certified products are compatible for use'. No Battery Mode needs a 'dedicated power source'.
findings.source_title: New tools for any crew | Samsung Business
findings.note: Samsung does not name which earlier accessories carry over.

findings.label: Third-party keyboard fit and requirement
findings.value: Gamber-Johnson 7160-1872-00 Slim Attachable Keyboard, $160. Fits the Tab Active Pro, Tab Active4 Pro and Tab Active5 Pro. The Active4 Pro and Active5 Pro are compatible 'when used with the Samsung Rubber Boot'. The Mobility Bundle option is listed for the Active4 Pro only.
findings.source_title: Samsung Tab Active4 / Tab Active4 & 5 Pro Slim Attachable Keyboard | Gamber-Johnson
findings.note: The keyboard has no ports of its own. The tablet charges through its own USB-C port.

findings.label: Regional limit on the 5G option
findings.value: The optional 5G Sub-6 module is 'Only available in US, UK, EU, Australia and New Zealand'. The bridge battery keeps the tablet alive 'roughly 30 seconds' with the main battery bay empty.
findings.note: ChatGPT received this page as result 12, so it is not new. Top-side expansion modules are mutually exclusive. CPUs are Core Ultra 200V.
